_doc: Generated by auditing the already-built site (this repo predates the harness workflow — there was no brief to ingest). Each entry: { id, status, builders, nota }.
_status: pending | in_progress | done — only ONE feature may be in_progress at a time.
_builders: subset of [front-end-astro, seo-guide-lines]. Sections -> front-end-astro; close each page with seo-guide-lines.

features.nota: index.astro — GlobalHero, ClientHurts, Solution, ServicesLanding, LatestProjects variants, SocialProof, CTABanner.
nosotros.astro — AboutBio, AboutMission, AboutStats, AboutFoundationsAlt, AboutServiceLinks.
contacto.astro — HeroAbout/contact hero + ContactForm wired to src/actions/contact/getContact.ts (Astro Action + Resend).
servicios/diseno-web-estrategico.astro via ServiceLayout — AstroVsWordpressTable, ServiceProblemSection, ServiceSolutionSection, ServicesStepsProcess.
blog/index.astro via BlogLayout — lists the `blog` content collection (4 posts).
blog/[slug].astro via PostLayout — BlogPosting schema, highlight.js code blocks, reading-time.
src/content/works — 10 portfolio entries, rendered on the homepage LatestProjects sections.
src/config/seo.ts — COMPANY_INFO, DEFAULT_SEO, generatePageSEO, Service/FAQ/HowTo/BreadcrumbList/Organization/Person JSON-LD generators.
src/utils/llms.ts + /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /llms/[slug].txt, /llms/servicios/[slug].txt; robots.txt policy for AI crawlers aligned with Cloudflare edge rules (commit 59704e9).
astro-webmcp integration in astro.config.mjs over blog/servicios/nosotros/contacto collections — exposes site content to browser-resident AI agents (WebMCP).

src/components/ui/CTABanner.astro and src/components/section/landing/LatestProjects.2.astro still use Tailwind v3 `bg-gradient-to-*` instead of v4 `bg-linear-to-*`. Still renders (v4 keeps the alias) — low priority, fix opportunistically if either file is touched.

`pnpm check` reports 3 pre-existing TS errors in src/data/mockGoogleReviews.ts: profile_photo_url: "" is not assignable to type ImageMetadata (lines 47, 55, 63). Found while wiring pnpm verify — not caused by this harness migration, needs its own fix (either type the field as string | ImageMetadata or supply a real ImageMetadata import).
